origin.description: Send a signal to a process.

arguments.name: pid
arguments.text: Process id. A non-positive id does not send a signal.

arguments.name: signal
arguments.text: Signal number. The default is SIGTERM.

origin.details: Returns TRUE when the signal is delivered and FALSE when it is not.

translation.description: Send a signal to a process.

arguments.name: pid
arguments.text: Process id. A non-positive id does not send a signal.

arguments.name: signal
arguments.text: Signal number. The default is SIGTERM.

translation.details: os.kill. A non-positive pid returns False without sending a signal. OSError is False.
translation.example:
import subprocess
from tools import pskill
proc = subprocess.Popen(["sleep", "30"])
print(pskill(proc.pid))
proc.wait(timeout=2)
